community.description: The community to connect the bridge to.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the community.manage permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.

errors.name: BridgeNotFound
errors.description: The handle or DID does not resolve to an identity.

errors.name: AlreadyRegistered
errors.description: This bridge is already installed in this community.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.

main.description: Connects a bridge to a community by its handle or DID, for bridges that set up rooms with commands in the channels they can use. Writes a registration with no linked or open channels.
